panel_statement: Sample size first, score second, money never. With 137 played games in the corpus, a 11-9 record and a 19-1 record are both ordinary outcomes for a coin. Only a proper score with an interval can tell them apart — and at this n, even that cannot resolve an edge smaller than the intervals below.
